page0.text:
I have to go see what happened to Saber.
Despite Saber's stoicism, she seemed sociable enough, so I think she ought to have handled Fuji-nee and Sakura okayish. But still, I'm worried.

page1.text:
"...I bet Saber's already awake."
Then there's only one place she can be.
Sakura is in the living room, so Saber should be...

page2.text: Just as I thought, Saber is in the dojo.

page3.text:
"Shirou...? What is it? I believe it is still early to be awake."
"Huh? No, this is normal for me since I have to prepare breakfast."

page4.text:
"I see... I'm surprised, you wake up rather early."
It must've been really unexpected for Saber to be surprised over something like that.

page5.text:
"...Yeah, I guess I am an early bird.
But it isn't that big a deal. Is it really that surprising that I'd be awake, Saber?"
"Oh... No, uh, pardon me. Taiga is still asleep, so I hastily assumed the rest of the Emiya household was also slow to rise."

page6.text:
"Ah, yeah, I gotcha. She sleeps like a rock."
Yeah.
And she's a restless sleeper too, come to think of it.
It must've been hard for Sakura and Saber to get any shut-eye.

page7.text:
"By the way, good morning, Saber. How did you sleep?"
"Well, thank you. Since we did not have a battle yesterday, I am not at all fatigued."

page8.text:
"That was good. I thought you might have had some trouble because Fuji-nee tosses and turns a lot.
...It also seemed like you were up pretty late. If it gets too loud, I can tell them to give you a separate room."
Given Saber's personality, I can't imagine she finds it entirely comfortable sharing space with Fuji-nee.

page9.text:
"There is no need for that. As long as there is no issue, I would like to go with Taiga's proposal."
"You sure? Well, if you can do that, it would make things easier..."
You know, I feel like she's a little more approachable now. There's a bit of warmth in her tone.

page10.text:
"There something about Fuji-nee that strikes your fancy?"
"Yes, Taiga is a good person. I find it rare for someone to be so guileless. As I understand that she has helped raise you, I follow why you are also so earnest."

page11.text:
"...I don't know if I should take that as a compliment..."
"I mean it as one. I have only known her for a short time, but I feel I understand her well."

page12.text:
Makes sense.
I do think she's an open book like that.
The real problem begins with whether what you read makes sense, but that's a different story.

page13.text:
"So you were able to get along with Sakura too, right? Sakura isn't as bad as Fuji-nee."
"I believe that is true, however I have not come to an understanding with her quite yet. I would not characterize it as open hostility, but she is hesitant to lower her guard."

page14.text:
"...Hm. So you haven't talked with her yet?"
"We have spoken and come to an accord. As you say, she is a kind person like Taiga."
"...Oh. Then there shouldn't be a problem."
I sigh with relief.
